title: New 'Nippon Anime Awards' Event Announced for November 2027
content:
The Tokyo Anime Next event at Tokyo Tatemono Brillia Hall announced on Monday the new "Nippon Anime Awards" event, which will take place at SGC Hall Ariake on November 21, 2027.

The event's vision is to "create a timeless anime award that represents Japan and stands the test of time, marking the first step toward that future."

The special one-time Tokyo Anime Next event took place in Tokyo from October 30-November 2.

The Tokyo Anime Award Festival (TAAF) announced in September that it had concluded its events as of last March. TAAF 2026 took place from March 13-16.

TAAF launched in 2014 as an independent festival and has had 13 iterations. It was an evolution of the Tokyo Anime Award, which was part of the Tokyo International Anime Fair from 2002-2013.

title: New Disney Villains Anime Confirms Season 2 Disney+ Release Date With First Look
content:
A major anime giving the classic Disney Villains roster a surprise makeover has now set the release date for its return to Disney+ with the first look and details for its next big season. Disney+ has increasingly become a surprise home for new anime releases thanks to not only some big streaming license wins, but also a number of original projects that are showing off a whole new anime look for their respective Disney franchises. And Disney Twisted-Wonderland The Animation has to be the most notable yet.

Disney Twisted-Wonderland The Animation adapts the original mobile game title of the same name, and imagines an alternate universe where classic Disney Villains instead look like very attractive anime men . With a school dedicated to factions for each of these classic villain makeovers, the second season of the anime is now slated to make its debut with Disney+ this December. Check out the first look at Disney Twisted-Wonderland The Animation ~Episode of Savanaclaw~ below.

Disney Twisted-Wonderland The Animation Season 2 Confirms Disney+ Release Date

Disney Twisted-Wonderland The Animation ~Episode of Savanaclaw~ will be making its debut with Disney+ in Japan on December 23rd , and will likely be available for streaming with Hulu in the United States when it hits (though that has yet to be fully confirmed as of this time). The new season will be running for eight episodes in total, and will be streaming on a weekly release basis. Together with this first look at the next season of the series, the production staff and voice cast have also been confirmed for the coming episodes as well. And it features a returning staff.

Takahiro Natori continues to serve as chief director and script supervisor for Disney Twisted-Wonderland The Animation ~Episode of Savanaclaw~ while Shin Katagai serves as director for Yumeta Company and Graphinica after their time with the first season. Yoichi Kato provides the scripts for the series, Hanaka Nakano and Akane Sato provide the character designs, and Takumi Ozawa returns from the original mobile game release to compose the music for the anime too. This is the second major arc of a planned trilogy for the anime adaptation.

What to Know for Disney Twisted-Wonderland Season 2

Disney Twisted-Wonderland The Animation was originally announced as a three arc plan for the anime adaptation taking on the Episode of Heartslabyul, Episode of Savanaclaw, and Episode of Octavinelle arcs from the original mobile game title. The first season was inspired by the Queen of Hearts from Alice in Wonderland, and the second season is inspired by The Lion King’s Scar. And returning actors previously seen in the debut season are those students who are in the Savanaclaw faction of the school.

These include Yuichiro Umehara as Leona Kingscholar, Taito Ban as Jack Howl, and Aoi Ichikawa as Ruggie Bucchi. Taking over the protagonist role for this new season is Fairouz Ai as Yuuka Hirasaka, a student who finds herself in this new fantasy land Isekai style. It’s not quite clear just yet how the events of the first season will impact the second, but it’s certainly something big to look forward to in the episodes to come. Are you going to check out this Disney anime’s return later this year? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Black Clover Season 2 Preview Reveals First Look at Noelle’s Most Powerful Form
content:
Black Clover Season 2 is gearing up for the fight against the next member of the Dark Triad, and the first look at the anime’s next episode is showing off Noelle Silva’s most powerful form. Fans have been waiting five years for the anime to get to the Spade Kingdom Raid arc, and it’s because the fights against the Dark Triad have some of the biggest moments from Yuki Tabata’s original manga series overall. With lots of new forms and power ups to look forward to , it’s going to be a big season.

Black Clover Season 2 has now ended the fight against the first member of the Dark Triad in order to put a stop to the Advent of Qliphoth ritual with its latest episode , and now it’s time to shift its focus to the next member, Vanica. With Noelle completing her training in the Heart Kingdom, the first look and preview details for Black Clover Season 2 Episode 6 showcase the new form she’s unlocked as a result. You can check out the images in the gallery below.

Black Clover Season 2 Episode 6 Confirms Release Date & Synopsis

Black Clover Season 2 Episode 6 is titled “The Holy Valkyrie” and will be making its debut in Japan on November 7th, and will be streaming exclusively with Crunchyroll when it hits for fans in North America and other international territories. After Magna had defeated Dante in the latest episode, it’s time for the refocus on the fight against Vanica. While Charlotte and Rill had been holding her back before, things have now shifted as Noelle has made her way to the Spade Kingdom following her training of her mana in the Heart Kingdom.

The synopsis for the episode further teases her new power up and form that comes through her new mana mastery as well, “ After a fierce hand-to-hand battle, Magna emerged victorious against Dante ! This leaves only two members of the Dark Triad remaining to be defeated in order to stop the arrival of the Qliphoth,” the synopsis begins before revealing how Vanica is making things even tougher thanks to her control over Lolopechka,” One of them, Vanica, uses her own blood magic, along with the demonic power of talisman magic, to control Lolopechka, whom she abducted from the Heart Kingdom, and make her attack Charlotte and Rill.”

What’s Next for Black Clover Season 2?

But while the synopsis sees Vanica taking control of the Heart Kingdom’s Queen, Noelle and Gaja arrive on the scene just in time to save her, “–Just then, Noelle and Gaja arrive. To counter the demonic power, Noelle has borrowed the power of the water spirit Undine and acquired the magic of the ‘Sanctuary’!” When we had last seen Noelle and the others , it was clear that they acquired a new sense of control over their mana following their time training in the Heart Kingdom.

While the synopsis does not reveal the name of Noelle’s new form just yet, it does tease that it comes from Noelle uniting her power with the water spirit Undine. It takes her a necessary step forward against the Dark Triad, and is thankfully going to put her on the same playing field as Asta and Yuno as the third major pillar of the series . What are you hoping to see from Noelle in the next episode? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Voice Actor Ryūji Nakagi Dies at 89
content:
There was a private funeral for close relatives.

Nakagi was born on October 24, 1936 in Tokyo.

Nakagi's roles included Gōzō Yūtenji in Yawara! A Fashionable Judo Girl , Tokuo Nakagawa in Oishinbo , Rupert in Master Keaton , Sakuma in Patlabor , Seiji in Silent Service , and Krusenstern in The Legend of the Galactic Heroes .

title: Comic CMOA Partially Resumes Service
content:
NTT Solmare announced on Thursday that its Comic CMOA manga service has partially resumed service, after it suspended service for maintenance for almost two weeks due to an unauthorized external access.

As of Thursday, some features of the service have resumed, including: viewing of purchased works via web browser, use of unlimited reading service via web browser, changing member information, request for cancellation of registered monthly plans, and request for cancellation of registered unlimited reading services. The company noted that members have to reset their password to be able to use the features.

The service's bookshelf function is scheduled to resume soon, and the function to purchase works and points is scheduled to resume sequentially for each payment method. Other functions that have not resumed yet are automatic purchase of new releases, unsubscribing from the site, new member registration, and checking of history records such as points, purchases, and monthly subscription.

NTT Solmare urged users to be cautious of suspicious emails and other communications, and also urged users to change their password on any other service that used the same combination of email and password.

Meanwhile, members who use the service outside of Japan still cannot access the website due to its access restriction from outside Japan and via VPN (Virtual Private Network). This issue was not mentioned in NTT Solmare 's latest announcement.

The service announced on October 15 an emergency maintenance, and gave an update that evening that there was a high likelihood of an unauthorized external access to its servers. The service confirmed the next day the unauthorized external access to its servers, resulting in information leakage of some its members. Leaked member information includes email address, date of birth, gender, nickname, and hashed password (a password that has been converted into a special string of characters, making it unreadable).

On October 18, the company stated that it has identified the cause of the unauthorized external access and is implementing preventive measures and preparing to resume services in collaboration with specialized organizations. The service noted that to resume services, additional steps are necessary to ensure further safety measures.

In addition to previously reported leaked information, the service has confirmed that certain system log files were also accessed and retrieved. In its update on October 21, the service confirmed that there are approximately 4.2 million affected entries in the accessed system log files. Affected entries include email address, nickname, date of birth, and gender, and may also include duplicate information about the same customer. The service also confirmed that 319 items of registration information on the member database have been leaked.

The service also assured that members' credit card information is not stored in the affected system and has not been leaked. Additionally, no purchase history and data in members' "My Bookshelf" section were confirmed to have been leaked or damaged, as to date.
author: ANN

title: AI no Idenshi's Kyūri Yamada Launches New Manga
content:
Kodansha 's Comic Days platform announced on Sunday Kyūri Yamada will launch a new manga titled Nanabun no Survivor ( The One-Seventh Survivor ) on Monday. The series will also serialize on Kodansha 's YanMaga Web platform beginning November 16.

The story follows "useless" high school student Naoya, who struggles to do the mundane things everyone else can. While confiding in his friend about his struggle in Shibuya, a catastrophic earthquake strikes and his difficult daily life is abruptly disrupted.

Yamada launched the AI no Idenshi (The Genes of AI) manga in Akita Shoten 's Weekly Shōnen Champion magazine in November 2015, and ended it in August 2017. Akita Shoten published eight volumes for the manga. AI localization company Orange Inc. 's e-bookstore service emaqi publishes the series in English.

The series inspired a television anime in July 2023.

The five-volume AI no Idenshi RED QUEEN sequel manga ran from 2017 to 2019, and the AI no Idenshi Blue Age second sequel manga launched in July 2020 and ended in October 2024.

title: Toshimichi Uzō Launches New Manga
content:
Shogakukan 's Manga ONE platform announced on Friday writer Toshimichi Uzō will launch a new manga with artist Yuitsu titled Yome wo Dungeon de Koroshitai (I Want to Kill My Bride in a Dungeon) on the platform on Tuesday.

Uzō's My Sweet Marriage to My Ex-Nemesis ( Soshiki no Shukuteki to Kekkon Shitara Mecha Amai ) light novel series is inspiring a television anime adaptation.

One Peace Books licensed the novels' manga adaptation in May, and will release the first volume on March 16, 2027.

Uzō published the first light novel volume in October 2023 under Kadokawa 's Dengeki Bunko imprint, with illustrations by Kewi Hayashi . The fourth novel volume shipped in August 2025, and the fifth volume will ship on November 10.

Shīme (Si-me) launched the manga in Kadokawa 's Dengeki Maoh magazine in November 2024. Kadokawa published the manga's first compiled book volume in June 2025, and published the second volume on July 27.

title: The Bloodthirsty Bride Devours the King Manga Gets TV Anime in 2027
content:
A website opened on Monday to announce that a television anime of writer Shiki and artist Yū Shinonome's The Bloodthirsty Bride Devours the King (Chi ni Ueta Hanayome wa Ō o Kurau) manga will air next year.

The "forbidden dark romantic fantasy" is set in an era of war. Kate, a princess maiden with vampiric powers, enters an arranged marriage with Luka, the mightiest king of the realm, to protect her motherland. However, on their first night, the scent of his blood awakens her true nature, which shakes their bond to the core. Is the destined couple's bond merely a contract, instincts, or love?

Mariko Iwazaki is directing the anime at IMAGICA Infos and Imageworks Studio , and Shiki is personally writing the scripts. The company en-dolphin is producing the project. Taeko Miura is directing the sound at the studio RD , and Kujira Yumemi ( As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I'll Use My Appraisal Skill , Chillin' in Another World With Level 2 Super Cheat Powers ) is composing the music. Kazuya Takahashi is credited with production supervision.

The original manga has been available in individual chapters or volumes on various Japanese digital services including honto, and the 29th chapter and fourth volume debuted in October.

title: My Lovesick Life as a '90s Otaku's Nico Nicholson Launches New Manga
content:
Kodansha 's Be Love magazine announced on Friday Nico Nicholson will launch a new manga titled Yosojito Konkatsu in the next issue on December 1.

The magazine teases the series with the tagline: "I was fine with living alone, however — the search for something before the 'however' begins!"

Nicholson ended the My Lovesick Life as a '90s Otaku ( Inishie Otaku no Koiwazurai ) manga in Kodansha 's Kiss magazine in February 2023. Kodansha shipped the fourth and final volume in May 2023. Kodansha USA publishes the manga in English and shipped the fourth volume in August 2024.

title: New Resident Evil Reboot Film Earns US$400 Million Globally
content:
According to Box Office Mojo, the film has earned US$399,998,502 globally: US$157,398,502 in the United States and US$242,600,000 internationally.

The film ranked at #7 in the U.S. last weekend, earning an estimated US$2,525,000 from Friday to Sunday.

According to Variety, the film is now the highest-grossing installment in the live-action horror franchise.

The film opened in the United States on September 18. The film ranked at #1 and earned an estimated US$60 million in its opening weekend in the U.S.

The film opened in Japan on October 9, and ranked at #2 in its opening weekend.

The film stars Austin Abrams ( Weapons , Euphoria , Wolfs ) as Bryan. The cast also includes Zach Cherry , Kali Reis , and Paul Walter Hauser ( Richard Jewell , Black Bird , The Fantastic Four: First Steps ).

Zach Cregger ( Barbarian , Weapons ) directed the new film. Constantin Film and PlayStation Productions produced the new reboot film. Shay Hatten ( John Wick: Chapter 4 , Zack Snyder's Army of the Dead ) co-wrote the screenplay along with Cregger. Constantin's Robert Kulzer , Vertigo Entertainment 's Roy Lee ( Minecraft ), Miri Yoon ( Woman of the Hour ), and PlayStation Productions produced the movie, and Nicole Brown oversaw it. Dariusz Wolski was the director of photography.

This film is the eighth live-action film in the franchise.
